主要内容: SAP SE, a multinational software company, announced that the Executive Board and the Supervisory Board recommend shareholders approve a dividend of €1.85 per share for the fiscal year 2020 at the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The announcement was made in a press release issued on February 25, 2021. The document also mentioned that two by-elections of shareholder representatives in the SAP Supervisory Board will be held at the 2021 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The press release included forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties that could affect SAP's future financial results. The information is provided in compliance with U.S. securities regulations and is part of SAP's filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
